target.title: fix(telegram): surface draft stream delivery failures at warn level
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When Telegram draft/preview streaming fails — `sendMessage`/`editMessageText` rejections, a missing message id from `sendMessage`, or preview cleanup failures — the failure is reported only through `logVerbose`. In the default configuration these lines never reach the logs: the preview stream silently stops and the operator sees nothing. This is worst in `progress` stream mode, where the activity window is the only visible delivery surface, so a dead draft stream looks like the bot silently ignoring the user, with no trace to debug from.

Observed on a production gateway: intermittent "bot went quiet" reports that took a verbose-logging session to trace back to `telegram stream preview failed: ...` errors that had been happening invisibly.

Closes #111064

## Why This Change Was Made

`createTelegramDraftController` wired the draft stream's `warn` callback to `logVerbose` (`extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch-draft.ts`). The failure messages themselves originate in `extensions/telegram/src/draft-stream.ts` ("telegram stream preview failed: ...", "telegram stream preview stopped (missing message id from sendMessage)", "telegram stream preview cleanup failed: ...", "telegram stream preview cleanup was not confirmed ..."), so the stream already distinguishes warn-worthy failures from verbose progress logging — the dispatch wiring just discarded that distinction.

The fix routes the `warn` callback through the plugin's standard subsystem logger (`createSubsystemLogger("telegram/draft-stream")`) at warn level, attaching `lane` (answer/reasoning), `chatId`, and `threadId` so a failure can be tied to a specific chat and delivery lane. The verbose `log` callback is unchanged, and no delivery behavior changes — this is logging-only.

## User Impact

Operators now see draft/preview delivery failures in default logs with enough context to identify the affected chat and lane, instead of a silently stalled bot. No change to message delivery, retries, or stream behavior.

## Evidence

- New test in the existing dispatch failure harness: `extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch.draft-failures-progress.test.ts` — "routes draft stream failures to the warn-level telegram logger with lane context" proves the warn callback passed to `createTelegramDraftStream` emits on the `telegram/draft-stream` subsystem logger at warn level with `{ lane, chatId, threadId }`, not on the verbose path.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-telegram.config.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch.draft-failures-progress.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/draft-stream.test.ts` — 103 passed.
- `.../bot-message-dispatch.draft-finalization.test.ts .../bot-message-dispatch.draft-rotation.test.ts` — 27 passed.
- Extensions tsgo lane: no errors in touched files (only pre-existing, unrelated `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` errors present at base).
- The equivalent patch has been running on a production gateway since 2026-07-11 and has surfaced real preview failures that were previously invisible.

This PR was AI-assisted (implemented with Claude Code; reviewed by the operator).


This fix was developed with AI assistance; the change and its validation were reviewed by the submitting author.


## Runtime evidence (added after ClawSweeper review)

### Runtime proof: induced Telegram outage, BEFORE vs AFTER

**Harness.** A driver (tsx against this checkout) runs the real production bundle end to end: `createTelegramDraftController` from `extensions/telegram/src/bot-message-dispatch-draft.ts` builds its draft lanes, the lanes construct the real `createTelegramDraftStream` from `extensions/telegram/src/draft-stream.ts`, and the `warn`/`log` callbacks are the module's own wiring (`logVerbose` on main; the `telegram/draft-stream` subsystem logger from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/runtime-env` on this branch). Logging runs at the default configuration (console level `info`, file level `info`; the state dir is isolated via `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, with only `logging.file` pointed into the harness directory). The single mocked piece is the Bot API transport: `sendMessage` succeeds once (the preview lands as `message_id=4242` in synthetic chat `987654321`, topic `777`), then the connection dies — every subsequent `editMessageText` and the teardown `deleteMessage` reject with `ECONNRESET` (`socket hang up`). The stream makes 4 edit attempts (3 retryable, then terminal stop) plus 1 cleanup delete attempt.

For BEFORE, the harness swaps in the `origin/main` version of `bot-message-dispatch-draft.ts` (the git blob hash printed inside each capture proves which version ran); for AFTER it restores the branch file. Same driver, same induced failure. Excerpts below are verbatim except: the `date:`/`node:` header lines are omitted, `[worktree]` substitutes the local checkout path, `hostname` is redacted, and gateway-log `_meta` is trimmed (`…`) to its level fields. All chat/thread/message ids are synthetic harness values.

**BEFORE — origin/main, default log config: the outage is invisible.** Four failed preview edits and a failed cleanup delete produce zero operator-visible output, and the gateway log file stays empty — the dead progress stream looks like the bot silently ignoring the user:

```
=== BEFORE: origin/main bot-message-dispatch-draft.ts, default log config ===
HEAD: ee92447d8c86658c413d9e6ada63e6c26b9decba (fix/telegram-draft-visible-failures)
bot-message-dispatch-draft.ts blob: c95d8b8dd3b723a467189ab3b7638ab25278f16e
  origin/main blob: c95d8b8dd3b723a467189ab3b7638ab25278f16e
  branch HEAD blob: 0f2a7698cf1b80fba8d716db16c05dd31f5b7d13
---- console output (default gateway log config) ----
harness: initial preview delivered (sendMessage calls=1, message_id=4242)
harness: induced preview edit failures (editMessageText calls=4)
harness: cleanup requested (detached delete fires after the preview dwell delay)
harness: done (deleteMessage calls=1)
---- gateway log file ([worktree]/.proof/state/logs/openclaw-gateway.log) ----
(gateway log file is empty / was not written)
```

**BEFORE — same run with verbose enabled (honesty check).** The failure text exists, but only as unlabeled verbose console chatter, and still never reaches the gateway log file:

```
---- console output (default gateway log config + verbose flag) ----
harness: verbose mode enabled (equivalent to a --verbose gateway run)
telegram stream preview ready (maxChars=4000, throttleMs=1000)
harness: initial preview delivered (sendMessage calls=1, message_id=4242)
telegram stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up
telegram stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up
telegram stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up
telegram stream preview failed: socket hang up
harness: induced preview edit failures (editMessageText calls=4)
harness: cleanup requested (detached delete fires after the preview dwell delay)
telegram stream preview cleanup failed: socket hang up
harness: done (deleteMessage calls=1)
---- gateway log file ([worktree]/.proof/state/logs/openclaw-gateway.log) ----
(gateway log file is empty / was not written)
```

**AFTER — this branch, default log config.** The same induced outage is surfaced at warn level on the console (the console formatter strips the redundant `telegram ` message prefix after the `[telegram]` subsystem tag):

```
=== AFTER: branch fix/telegram-draft-visible-failures, default log config ===
bot-message-dispatch-draft.ts blob: 0f2a7698cf1b80fba8d716db16c05dd31f5b7d13
  origin/main blob: c95d8b8dd3b723a467189ab3b7638ab25278f16e
  branch HEAD blob: 0f2a7698cf1b80fba8d716db16c05dd31f5b7d13
---- console output (default gateway log config) ----
harness: initial preview delivered (sendMessage calls=1, message_id=4242)
[telegram] stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up
[telegram] stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up
[telegram] stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up
[telegram] stream preview failed: socket hang up
harness: induced preview edit failures (editMessageText calls=4)
harness: cleanup requested (detached delete fires after the preview dwell delay)
[telegram] stream preview cleanup failed: socket hang up
harness: done (deleteMessage calls=1)
```

and lands in the gateway log file at `WARN` with the full message and the draft-stream metadata (`lane` / `chatId` / `threadId`); 3 of the 5 captured lines:

```
{"0":"{\"subsystem\":\"telegram/draft-stream\"}","1":{"lane":"answer","chatId":987654321,"threadId":777},"2":"telegram stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up","_meta":{…,"logLevelId":4,"logLevelName":"WARN",…},"time":"2026-07-19T00:42:01.846+00:00","hostname":"[redacted]","message":"telegram stream preview edit failed (retrying): socket hang up"}
{"0":"{\"subsystem\":\"telegram/draft-stream\"}","1":{"lane":"answer","chatId":987654321,"threadId":777},"2":"telegram stream preview failed: socket hang up","_meta":{…,"logLevelId":4,"logLevelName":"WARN",…},"time":"2026-07-19T00:42:01.994+00:00","hostname":"[redacted]","message":"telegram stream preview failed: socket hang up"}
{"0":"{\"subsystem\":\"telegram/draft-stream\"}","1":{"lane":"answer","chatId":987654321,"threadId":777},"2":"telegram stream preview cleanup failed: socket hang up","_meta":{…,"logLevelId":4,"logLevelName":"WARN",…},"time":"2026-07-19T00:42:05.845+00:00","hostname":"[redacted]","message":"telegram stream preview cleanup failed: socket hang up"}
```

**Repro:** `bash .proof/run-all.sh` from the branch checkout (the harness lives under `.proof/`, kept out of the PR diff via the worktree git exclude); raw captures are written to `.proof/before.log` and `.proof/after.log`.
